reference.title: Azure Resource Graph table and resource type reference + Explore your Azure resources with Resource Graph + Resources - Resources (REST, 2024-04-01) + Azure Resource Graph sample queries for Microsoft Defender for Cloud

delivery.note: Azure Resource Graph is a QUERY service, not a push export. There is no documented delivery to Azure Storage, Log Analytics or Event Hub. The only documented file export is the manual 'Download as CSV' in Resource Graph Explorer, limited to 55000 records, whose column header is not published. delivery.path_template/format/compression are empty by design, not by omission.

important_caveat: The official documentation states: 'Azure Resource Graph scrubs PII information from our tables so you may see not see the same result as if you made a GET request on your resource directly.' The resources table representation of a VM is therefore NOT identical to the ARM GET representation.

tables.name: Resources
tables.description: The default table if a table isn't defined in the query. Most Resource Manager resource types and properties are here.

unverified.name: formal Resources table column schema (names + types)
unverified.reason: Microsoft publishes no page listing the resources table's columns with types (unlike Azure Monitor tables, which have explicit column tables). All names were read from official JSON response examples; the types are not asserted by any consulted page.

unverified.name: Resources column data types (kind, managedBy, plan, sku, tags, tenantId, ...)
unverified.reason: They appear in examples as ""/{} which does not fix a type (string vs object vs nullability).

unverified.name: required flags for any Resources column
unverified.reason: No consulted official page states that any resources column is always present.

unverified.name: complete properties.* list for microsoft.compute/virtualmachines in the resources table
unverified.reason: Only the paths listed in the .md are proven (official example JSON plus the official REST query example). No complete list is published, and the documented PII scrub means the set may differ from ARM.

unverified.name: properties.extended.* for VMs beyond instanceView.powerState.code
unverified.reason: Only that path is exemplified officially; extended properties are documented as a preview feature.

unverified.name: official enumeration of SecurityResources resource types

unverified.name: SecurityResources field data types
unverified.reason: No consulted official page publishes a type table; number/array/dynamic values in this file are the spec author's classification based on how the official queries use them (tolong, todouble, mv-expand, todynamic).

unverified.name: delivery.path_template / delivery.format / delivery.compression
unverified.reason: Resource Graph is a query service, not a push export; no storage path, file format or compression is documented. The only documented file export is the manual Resource Graph Explorer CSV (55000 record cap) whose column header is not published. Empty by design.

unverified.name: resourcechanges / ResourceChanges table schema
unverified.reason: The 'Get resource changes' page shows an example payload and defers to the REST reference /rest/api/resources/changes for the full field reference. That reference was not read in this investigation, so no field is asserted here.
